_about: The ElevenLabs agent of Bto's phone AI order line (ADR-0232 #15). push.mjs sends this file (keys starting with _ left out) with conversation_config.agent.prompt.prompt read from prompt.mn.md and prompt.tool_ids from tools.json.
_llm: prompt.llm: claude-sonnet-5-5 since 2026-11-20 (the owner, after the first real call: the agent must be very smart at finding products); thinking off (thinking_budget 0) for the latency. push.mjs --llm claude-haiku-4-5 switches back for one push; change the value here to switch for good.
_asr: asr.keywords comes from keywords.json at push time (brand words the recogniser should prefer; Scribe realtime takes at most 50 of at most 20 characters). push.mjs --asr scribe_v3_live tries the newer recogniser for one push.
_voice: tts.voice_id: null keeps the provider's default voice. Pick a voice that speaks Mongolian well in the ElevenLabs voice library, put its id here and push again.
name: Bto phone order line

agent.first_message: Сайн байна уу, Оргил бөөний төвийн захиалгын AI туслах байна. Яриа бичигдэж байгаа. Юугаар туслах вэ?
agent.max_conversation_duration_message: Уучлаарай, ярианы хугацаа дууслаа. Ажилтан тань руу эргэж залгана. Баярлалаа, сайхан амраарай.
